knobs.name: sP
knobs.what: world units per orbit unit: the size of the tangle (where each planet is)

knobs.name: sL
knobs.what: world units per unit of spin: the radius of the six shells

knobs.name: sA
knobs.what: world units per unit of weight size (the training cloud's width and depth)

knobs.name: sC
knobs.what: world units per unit of the sum a^2 - b^2: the gap between the five layers

knobs.name: hT
knobs.what: height of the time axis in the training cloud before it is re-plotted by the sum

knobs.name: dotR
knobs.what: dot radius of the 30,000 recall dots (world units, before the depth size cue)

knobs.name: dotRNet
knobs.what: dot radius of the 24,000 training dots

knobs.name: sizeCue
knobs.what: how much nearer dots are drawn larger (depth size cue)

knobs.name: fog
knobs.what: fog toward the far side of a cloud (manager level cap 0.3)

knobs.name: stag
knobs.what: stagger of the moves: each orbit or neuron leaves up to this fraction later, its dots together

knobs.name: brightFollow
knobs.what: how much brighter the followed orbit's 100 dots are (brighter, not bigger)

knobs.name: ghost
knobs.what: how much of the recall cloud still shows while a published result is quoted (a ghost)

knobs.name: dimOthers
knobs.what: how far the dots of the other 475 neurons sink while one neuron per layer is followed (they keep their layer colour)

knobs.name: cometLen
knobs.what: length of the lit trail behind each followed head, in per cent of that neuron's path

knobs.name: growComet
knobs.what: how much bigger the dots of a followed neuron's path are drawn (the head is drawn separately, headR)

knobs.name: pathBase
knobs.what: how lit the whole path of a followed neuron is (its 50 moments), ahead of and behind the head

knobs.name: headR
knobs.what: radius of the drawn head of a followed neuron (world units): its place at the current moment of the slide

knobs.name: headRing
knobs.what: radius of the thin ring round each head, in head radii (0 = no ring)

knobs.name: follow0
knobs.what: the followed neuron (unit = run x 8 + i) in layer 1, counted from the most negative sum; a long, smooth path

knobs.name: follow1
knobs.what: the followed neuron (unit = run x 8 + i) in layer 2, counted from the most negative sum; a long, smooth path

knobs.name: follow2
knobs.what: the followed neuron (unit = run x 8 + i) in layer 3, counted from the most negative sum; a long, smooth path

knobs.name: follow3
knobs.what: the followed neuron (unit = run x 8 + i) in layer 4, counted from the most negative sum; a long, smooth path

knobs.name: follow4
knobs.what: the followed neuron (unit = run x 8 + i) in layer 5, counted from the most negative sum; a long, smooth path

knobs.name: recLen
knobs.what: length of the comet that runs along the followed orbit's 100 dots (one lap = perS seconds)

knobs.name: growFollow
knobs.what: how much bigger the comet head (and, a little, the followed orbit's dots) are drawn

knobs.name: fdimRec
knobs.what: how far the other 29,900 recall dots sink so the followed orbit shows

knobs.name: ringOp
knobs.what: opacity of the thin outline ring round each shell

knobs.name: ringW
knobs.what: line weight of the shell outline rings

knobs.name: plateOp
knobs.what: opacity of the thin outline of each of the five layers

knobs.name: featOrbit
knobs.what: which of the 300 orbits is followed (its 100 dots a little brighter, one planet slides along its shell)

knobs.name: perS
knobs.what: seconds per lap of the followed planet

knobs.name: toyK
knobs.what: world units per unit of a sub-answer: box length (4, 7, 9 of them)

knobs.name: toyGap
knobs.what: gap between the three marks of a row, in units of a sub-answer

knobs.name: toyH
knobs.what: height of a toy mark

knobs.name: toyBoxD
knobs.what: depth of a toy mark

knobs.name: toyRow
knobs.what: row pitch in box depths

knobs.name: ansS
knobs.what: side of the answer cube at the end of each toy row

knobs.name: ansGap
knobs.what: gap before the answer cube, in units of a sub-answer

knobs.name: plateW
knobs.what: width of the plate under the toy

knobs.name: plateD
knobs.what: depth of the plate under the toy

knobs.name: rowStep
knobs.what: seconds between one row and the next counting in

knobs.name: treeW
knobs.what: half width of the question tree (x from the data runs -1 to 1)

knobs.name: treeD
knobs.what: distance between the three layers of the tree

knobs.name: treeBox
knobs.what: side of a question box

knobs.name: linkW
knobs.what: width of the thin bars to the parent

knobs.name: treeIn
knobs.what: seconds the 19 boxes take to count in

knobs.name: swapArc
knobs.what: how far the near-going child steps toward the camera while the two children swap (depth)

knobs.name: swapLift
knobs.what: how high the far-going child and its subtree lift off the plate while the two children swap

knobs.name: swapSecs
knobs.what: seconds the two children take to swap places

knobs.name: fov
knobs.what: lens, degrees (never changes inside a move)

knobs.name: lensX
knobs.what: lens shift: the subject sits left of the centre by this fraction of the half width (clear of the panel)

knobs.name: lensY
knobs.what: lens shift up (fraction of the half height), clear of the caption band

knobs.name: drift
knobs.what: ambient drift of the camera in degrees (holds stay within 3)

knobs.name: camHookAz
knobs.what: recall cloud, azimuth of the HOOK frame (the landing of M1 is the same frame)

knobs.name: camHookEl
knobs.what: recall cloud, elevation

knobs.name: camHookD
knobs.what: recall cloud, camera distance

knobs.name: camM0Az
knobs.what: M0: how far the camera orbits while the shells un-sort (M1 orbits back the same way)

knobs.name: camNetAz
knobs.what: training cloud, azimuth at the match cut

knobs.name: camNetEl
knobs.what: training cloud, elevation at the match cut

knobs.name: camNetD
knobs.what: training cloud, camera distance

knobs.name: camM2Az
knobs.what: M2: how far the camera orbits while the dots are re-plotted by the sum

knobs.name: camM2El
knobs.what: M2: elevation at the settle

knobs.name: camM3El
knobs.what: M3: elevation at the end of the bigger steps (low: the layers are seen edge-on)

knobs.name: camM3Dolly
knobs.what: M3: how far the camera pushes in (fraction of the distance)

knobs.name: camToyAz
knobs.what: toy, azimuth

knobs.name: camToyEl
knobs.what: toy, elevation

knobs.name: camToyD
knobs.what: toy, camera distance

knobs.name: camToyZ
knobs.what: toy, look-at depth

knobs.name: camTreeAz
knobs.what: tree, azimuth

knobs.name: camTreeEl
knobs.what: tree, elevation

knobs.name: camTreeD
knobs.what: tree, camera distance

knobs.name: camTreeZ
knobs.what: tree, look-at depth

knobs.name: camWideAz
knobs.what: Monday wide frame, azimuth

knobs.name: camWideEl
knobs.what: Monday wide frame, elevation

knobs.name: camWideD
knobs.what: Monday wide frame, camera distance

knobs.name: camWideZ
knobs.what: Monday wide frame, look-at depth (moves the tree up or down the stage)

knobs.name: tReveal
knobs.what: HOOK: seconds the 30,000 dots take to appear, shell by shell

knobs.name: tM0
knobs.what: M0 start: the rule is taken away (the shells un-sort)

knobs.name: tM0e
knobs.what: M0 end

knobs.name: tM1
knobs.what: M1 start: a blind search puts the tangle back on the shells

knobs.name: tM1e
knobs.what: M1 end

knobs.name: tGhost
knobs.what: the cloud dims to a ghost; the published result is quoted

knobs.name: tNet
knobs.what: match cut to the training cloud; the 24,000 dots start to count in

knobs.name: tNetC
knobs.what: the last training dot has arrived

knobs.name: tM2
knobs.what: M2 start: each dot is re-plotted by the sum

knobs.name: tM2e
knobs.what: M2 end

knobs.name: tFollow
knobs.what: one run's neurons brighten, the rest sink

knobs.name: tComet
knobs.what: the comet starts to run along every arc

knobs.name: tCometE
knobs.what: the comet has run the length of the arcs

knobs.name: tM3
knobs.what: M3 start: bigger steps

knobs.name: tM3e
knobs.what: M3 end

knobs.name: tToy
knobs.what: hard cut to the toy (3 marks)

knobs.name: tRows
knobs.what: the 6 rows start to count in

knobs.name: tSame
knobs.what: all rows one colour: the total is the same

knobs.name: tModel
knobs.what: rows recolour: the order-sensitive toy model

knobs.name: tChen
knobs.what: rows dim to a ghost; the published result is quoted

knobs.name: tTree
knobs.what: hard cut to the tree; the 19 boxes count in

knobs.name: tSwap
knobs.what: the two children of the 2nd question swap places; one node keeps a ring

knobs.name: tMon
knobs.what: Monday: the camera eases back to a wide frame

knobs.name: tMonE
knobs.what: end of the ease

knobs.name: tHon
knobs.what: the honest line on stage

knobs.name: pX
knobs.what: left edge of the readout panel (the right third of the stage)

knobs.name: pinX
knobs.what: the one pin: left edge of its word

knobs.name: pinY
knobs.what: the one pin: baseline of its word

knobs.name: monY
knobs.what: baseline of the first Monday line

knobs.name: honY
knobs.what: baseline of the first line of the honest sentence

knobs.name: stageSize
knobs.what: size of the set type (Monday question, honest sentence)

knobs.name: stageLH
knobs.what: line height of the set type
